issues.title: Unmirrored breadcrumb separators in RTL
issues.description: Breadcrumb separator chevrons point rightwards instead of leftwards in RTL reading order.
issues.evidence: Separators between 'בית', 'הגדרות סביבה', and 'כללי' render as '>' pointing rightward.
issues.suggestion: Flip separator chevrons to point leftwards in RTL direction.
issues.triageNote: Real defect: BreadcrumbSeparator default ChevronRight had no RTL handling; added rtl:rotate-180 to the default icon.

issues.title: Unmirrored breadcrumb separators
issues.description: Breadcrumb chevron separators point right instead of left for RTL navigation flow.
issues.evidence: The '>' separators between items point toward the starting item.
issues.suggestion: Mirror separator chevrons to point left in RTL mode.
issues.triageNote: Same root cause as pair-045 finding; single fix in breadcrumb.tsx (rtl:rotate-180 on default separator icon) covers both.
